source.subject: Email Summarizer Workflow – Parse Error Detected (2026-09-15)

proposed_action.subject: Re: Email Summarizer Workflow – Parse Error Detected (2026-09-15)
proposed_action.body:
Hi,

I wanted to flag something from this morning's email summarizer run that needs your attention.

The workflow triggered at 07:56 UTC on 2026-09-15 retrieved 40 emails (date range: 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-08), but a parse error was detected during processing. As a result, the execution summary is incomplete — the priority distribution table and downstream draft generation did not complete as expected.

Here's where things stand right now:
- The raw email retrieval completed successfully (40 messages pulled).
- The parse error interrupted the summarization and evaluation steps.
- No response drafts or executive briefs were produced in this run.

Our team is looking into the root cause of the parse error now. We'll have an update for you within the next 60 minutes, including whether a re-run is needed or if the data can be recovered from this session.

Apologies for the disruption — we know you rely on this workflow to stay on top of your inbox. We'll keep you posted.

Best,
Deconstruct Support

xai_explanation.trigger_rationale: The upstream workflow context explicitly flags '⚠️ Parse error detected' in the data status field and shows truncated output in the summary and key_points arrays. The evaluate_actions node returned empty arrays for drafts, exec_briefs, and skipped_accounts, confirming the pipeline did not complete. These signals collectively indicate a service-level processing failure affecting the tenant's workflow output.
xai_explanation.strategy_rationale: Categorized as service_outage because the workflow failed to produce its intended outputs (drafts, briefs) due to a system-side parse error — not a user configuration issue. Urgency is set to 7 rather than 9-10 because the affected data is synthetic test emails (not live production customer data), reducing immediate business impact. The draft acknowledges the failure honestly, states exactly what did and did not complete, avoids inventing a root cause, and commits to a 60-minute follow-up window consistent with the estimated_response_sla_minutes default.
